jobs.description:
Description

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

The Program Manager will lead the end-to-end development of Energy Storage System product, focusing on coordinating cross-functional teams and external partners to drive successful development, integration, and deployment. This role requires strong leadership to align stakeholders, mitigate risks, and maintain project timelines and budgets. The ideal candidate thrives in complex, multi-vendor environments and has a passion for clean energy technologies

Responsibilities

Stakeholder Coordination: Facilitate collaboration among diverse parties, including battery suppliers, inverter suppliers, field service and commissioning teams, system integrator, and internal cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, procurement, quality assurance, and operations).
Project Planning and Execution: Develop and maintain comprehensive project plan, timelines, milestones, and budgets. Track progress using tools like Gantt charts, risk registers, and performance metrics to ensure the program stays on schedule and within scope.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks across the supply chain and integration processes. Implement mitigation strategies and contingency plans to address issues proactively.
Communication and Reporting: Serve as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders. Prepare regular status updates, dashboards, and executive reports on project health, deliverables, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Integration Oversight: Manage the technical and operational integration of ESS components, ensuring compatibility between batteries, inverters, and other subsystems. Coordinate testing, validation, and commissioning activities to meet regulatory and performance standards.
Resource Allocation: Optimize resource utilization across teams. Negotiate with suppliers and partners to resolve conflicts and secure commitments.
Continuous Improvement: Analyze project outcomes to identify lessons learned. Drive process enhancements for future programs, incorporating feedback from all involved parties.
Compliance and Quality Assurance: Ensure adherence to industry standards, safety regulations (e.g., UL, IEC), and environmental guidelines throughout the development lifecycle.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related field); Master's degree or PMP certification preferred.
5+ years of experience in program or project management, ideally in the energy sector, renewable technologies, or complex hardware/software integration projects.
Proven track record managing multi-vendor projects, with experience in energy storage, batteries, inverters, or similar systems.
Strong understanding of energy storage technologies, including lithium-ion batteries, power conversion systems, and grid integration.

Required Skills

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana) and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
Analytical mindset with experience in risk assessment, budgeting, and forecasting.
Ability to work in a high-pressure environment, prioritizing tasks and adapting to changing requirements.
Familiarity with supply chain management, contract negotiation, and vendor performance evaluation.
Commitment to sustainability and innovation in the energy industry.

Hanwha Q CELLS America Inc. (“HQCA”) is a Qcells company, one of the world’s largest manufacturers and providers of solar photovoltaic (PV) products and solutions. Headquartered in Irvine, California, HQCA has been rapidly expanding its business in North America through the expansion of products and solutions, including distributed energy solutions, direct-to-homeowner solar sales and financing, and EPC services. We provide an opportunity to be part of an exciting and growing world-class global business in an interesting and expanding industry of the future.

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst who can turn complex business data into clear insights, reliable reporting, and practical recommendations. Translate business questions into analytical plans, clear requirements, and measurable outcomes.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst who can turn complex business data into clear insights, reliable reporting, and practical recommendations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys investigating business questions, developing useful dashboards, and helping teams understand what drives performance.

You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to define meaningful metrics, improve reporting accuracy, and identify opportunities across operations, customer experience, and business performance. The role combines hands-on analysis with direct stakeholder collaboration, giving you ownership of analytical projects from the initial question through to recommendations and follow-up measurement.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business questions into analytical plans, clear requirements, and measurable outcomes.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Build and maintain dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable visualization platform.
Analyze trends, investigate performance changes, and explain the factors behind key results.
Define and document KPIs, reporting logic, and metric calculations to support consistent decision-making.
Validate datasets, investigate discrepancies, and collaborate with data teams to resolve quality issues.
Automate recurring reports and reduce manual work while maintaining accuracy.
Present findings in concise reports and presentations tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Partner with stakeholders to prioritize requests and establish realistic delivery timelines.
Measure the results of business initiatives and recommend next steps based on the evidence.

Required Qualifications

4–8 years of relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related analytical role.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, and aggregations.
Hands-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; expertise in either platform is sufficient.
Strong Excel skills for analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.
Experience working with relational databases and combining information from multiple datasets.
Practical understanding of descriptive statistics, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Ability to distinguish between correlation and causation and communicate limitations in the data.
Experience gathering stakeholder requirements and independently delivering analytical projects.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain findings and their business implications.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation.
Exposure to a cloud data platform such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Azure.
Familiarity with data modeling, ETL/ELT workflows, and version control.
Experience with forecasting, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, or A/B testing.
Experience improving reporting processes or supporting self-service analytics.

Preferred qualifications are helpful, but candidates do not need experience with every listed tool.

What Success Looks Like

Stakeholders have access to accurate, understandable, and timely reporting.
Key metrics use consistent definitions and documented calculations.
Analysis explains the reasons behind performance changes and supports actionable decisions.
Recurring reporting requires less manual effort.
Findings are communicated clearly, including assumptions and limitations.

How to Apply

Submit your resume highlighting relevant analytical projects, the tools you used, and the business outcomes you supported. A portfolio is welcome but optional; please exclude confidential employer or client information.
